items.name: theme
items.title: House Theme
items.description: Mantine theme with house defaults for Button, Card, Paper and Modal.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Centered empty/zero-data placeholder with an optional icon and call to action.

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.description: Heading text shown below the icon.

EmptyState.name: description
EmptyState.description: Supporting text rendered under the title; nothing renders when omitted.

EmptyState.name: icon
EmptyState.description: Custom icon rendered inside the theme icon circle; defaults to an inbox icon.

EmptyState.name: action
EmptyState.description: Renders a button below the description that calls onClick when clicked; no button renders when omitted.

EmptyState.name: ...others
EmptyState.description: All other props are forwarded to the root <Center>, after its own py="xl", so both can be overridden. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Page title, description and right-aligned action slot with an optional divider.

PageHeader.name: title
PageHeader.description: Renders as the header's order-2 title text.

PageHeader.name: description
PageHeader.description: Renders dimmed helper text beneath the title when provided.

PageHeader.name: actions
PageHeader.description: Renders action controls in a trailing group aligned opposite the title.

PageHeader.name: withDivider
PageHeader.description: Controls whether a divider is rendered beneath the header content.

PageHeader.name: ...others
PageHeader.description: All other props are forwarded to the root <Stack>, so passthrough props can override its hardcoded gap/mb. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: Metric tile with label, value, optional icon and a trend row.

StatCard.name: label
StatCard.description: Renders the uppercase, muted caption identifying what the stat measures.

StatCard.name: value
StatCard.description: Renders the large, bold headline figure for the stat.

StatCard.name: diff
StatCard.description: Percentage change vs. the previous period; renders a colored trend row with an up/down arrow, and is hidden entirely when omitted.

StatCard.name: icon
StatCard.description: Renders inside a light-variant ThemeIcon at the top-right of the card; the icon slot is omitted entirely when not provided.

StatCard.name: ...others
StatCard.description: All other props are forwarded to the root Paper, after its own withBorder/p="md"/radius="md", so both can be overridden. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sortable table with loading skeletons, click-through rows and an empty state.

DataTable.name: data
DataTable.description: Rows to render. Sorting a column header does not mutate this array — internally the table sorts a copy of it and re-renders with the copy.

DataTable.name: columns
DataTable.description: Column definitions controlling header text, width, sortability and per-cell rendering.

DataTable.name: loading
DataTable.description: Shows skeleton placeholder rows instead of the table body while true.

DataTable.name: loadingRows
DataTable.description: Number of skeleton rows rendered while loading.

DataTable.name: emptyTitle
DataTable.description: Title shown by the empty state when there are no rows to display.

DataTable.name: emptyDescription
DataTable.description: Description shown by the empty state when there are no rows to display.

DataTable.name: onRowClick
DataTable.description: Makes rows clickable, enabling hover highlighting and a pointer cursor, and fires with the clicked row.

DataTable.name: getRowKey
DataTable.description: Derives the React key for each row; defaults to the row's index.

items.name: mantine-ui-license
items.title: Mantine UI License
items.description: Shared MIT license notice installed with Mantine UI-derived registry items.
items.docs: Verbatim MIT license from mantinedev/ui.mantine.dev at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908.

items.name: article-card
items.title: Article Card
items.description: Prop-driven article preview with author, rating and action affordances.

ArticleCard.name: image
ArticleCard.description: Cover image URL, rendered inside the linked card header.

ArticleCard.name: title
ArticleCard.description: Article title; also used as the image alt text and rendered as a link.

ArticleCard.name: description
ArticleCard.description: Summary text, clamped to four lines.

ArticleCard.name: authorName
ArticleCard.description: Byline shown in the card footer.

ArticleCard.name: authorAvatar
ArticleCard.description: Avatar image URL for the byline; a placeholder avatar renders when omitted.

ArticleCard.name: rating
ArticleCard.description: Text for the gradient badge over the image; no badge renders when omitted.

ArticleCard.name: href
ArticleCard.description: Destination for the image and title links.

ArticleCard.name: onLike
ArticleCard.description: Renders the like action icon and handles its click.

ArticleCard.name: onBookmark
ArticleCard.description: Renders the bookmark action icon and handles its click.

ArticleCard.name: onShare
ArticleCard.description: Renders the share action icon and handles its click.

ArticleCard.name: ...others
ArticleCard.description: All other props are forwarded to the root Card, after its own withBorder and radius="md", so both can be overridden. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI ArticleCard at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; demo data removed and replaced with typed props.

items.name: authentication-form
items.title: Authentication Form
items.description: Login and registration form with validation and optional social callbacks.

AuthenticationForm.name: initialMode
AuthenticationForm.description: Sets which mode the form starts in; the internal toggle then switches between login and register.

AuthenticationForm.name: heading
AuthenticationForm.description: Heading text rendered as "{heading}, {mode} with" above the form, e.g. "Welcome, login with".

AuthenticationForm.name: initialTerms
AuthenticationForm.description: Initial checked state of the terms-and-conditions checkbox shown in register mode. Upstream Mantine UI initializes it true, which renders a pre-checked consent box the user never touched; this registry defaults it false. Set it true only if your flow genuinely warrants a pre-checked consent.

AuthenticationForm.name: onSubmit
AuthenticationForm.description: Called with the validated form values and current mode when the form is submitted.

AuthenticationForm.name: onGoogle
AuthenticationForm.description: Renders the Google social button and handles its click; the social row and divider are hidden entirely when neither social handler is set.

AuthenticationForm.name: onGithub
AuthenticationForm.description: Renders the GitHub social button and handles its click; the social row and divider are hidden entirely when neither social handler is set.

AuthenticationForm.name: ...others
AuthenticationForm.description: All other props are forwarded to the underlying Paper. AuthenticationFormProps extends PaperProps, and the spread is applied after the component's own radius="md", p="lg", withBorder defaults, so any of those three can be overridden by the caller.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI AuthenticationForm at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; submission and social actions are exposed as callbacks.

items.name: button-progress
items.title: Progress Button
items.description: Button with an integrated timed progress layer and completion callback.

ButtonProgress.name: idleLabel
ButtonProgress.description: Sets the label shown before the action has started.

ButtonProgress.name: progressLabel
ButtonProgress.description: Sets the label shown while progress is animating toward completion.

ButtonProgress.name: completeLabel
ButtonProgress.description: Sets the label shown once the progress run has finished.

ButtonProgress.name: durationMs
ButtonProgress.description: Controls how long the simulated progress run takes to reach completion.

ButtonProgress.name: onComplete
ButtonProgress.description: Fires once the progress bar reaches 100% and the button switches to its complete state.

ButtonProgress.name: ...others
ButtonProgress.description: All other props are forwarded to the root <Button>, after its own fullWidth, so both can be overridden; onClick and color are controlled by the component's internal progress/complete state and always win. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI ButtonProgress at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; labels, duration and completion are configurable.

items.name: dnd-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: Accessible pointer and keyboard sortable list with reorder callbacks.

DndList.name: initialItems
DndList.description: Seeds the internal list state that the sortable items render from and reorder within.

DndList.name: onChange
DndList.description: Called with the full reordered item array whenever a drag ends on a different position.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI DndList at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; hardcoded periodic-table data was replaced with a reusable item contract.

items.name: stats-grid
items.title: Stats Grid
items.description: Responsive metric grid with custom icons, comparison labels and trends.

StatsGrid.name: items
StatsGrid.description: Renders one stat card per item, laying them out in a responsive grid that scales up to four columns on desktop based on the item count.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI StatsGrid at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; metrics and icons are supplied by the consumer.

items.name: table-sort
items.title: Sortable Table
items.description: Searchable and sortable name, email and company table with an empty state.

TableSort.name: data
TableSort.description: Rows to display, searched and sorted in place before rendering.

TableSort.name: searchPlaceholder
TableSort.description: Placeholder text for the search input above the table.

TableSort.name: emptyMessage
TableSort.description: Message rendered in a full-width row when the filtered data is empty.

TableSort.name: onRowClick
TableSort.description: Called with the row data when a table row is clicked; rows become clickable only when this is provided.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI TableSort at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; accepts consumer data and derives filtered rows without duplicating prop state.

items.name: cards-carousel
items.title: Cards Carousel
items.description: Responsive image-card carousel with consumer-owned data and optional actions.

CardsCarousel.name: items
CardsCarousel.description: Provides the ordered set of cards rendered as carousel slides.

CardsCarousel.name: actionLabel
CardsCarousel.description: Sets the label shown on each card's action button.

CardsCarousel.name: onSelect
CardsCarousel.description: Called when a card's action button is clicked and the item has no href, rendering the button and handling its click.

CardsCarousel.name: slideSize
CardsCarousel.description: Overrides the responsive default slide width (100% below the sm breakpoint, 50% above).

CardsCarousel.name: slidesToScroll
CardsCarousel.description: Overrides how many slides advance per navigation (defaults to 1 below the sm breakpoint, 2 above).

CardsCarousel.name: ...others
CardsCarousel.description: All other props are forwarded to the root <Carousel>, after its own slideGap, emblaOptions, and control props, so both can be overridden. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI CardsCarousel at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; hardcoded travel data became typed items with links or selection callbacks.

items.name: dropzone-button
items.title: Dropzone Button
items.description: Drag-and-drop file input with explicit accept, reject and picker behavior.

DropzoneButton.name: onDrop
DropzoneButton.description: Called with the accepted files when a valid drop or file-picker selection completes.

DropzoneButton.name: onReject
DropzoneButton.description: Called with the rejected files when a drop fails validation (type or size).

DropzoneButton.name: accept
DropzoneButton.description: Restricts accepted uploads to the given MIME types.

DropzoneButton.name: maxSize
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the maximum accepted file size in bytes.

DropzoneButton.name: multiple
DropzoneButton.description: Allows selecting or dropping more than one file at a time.

DropzoneButton.name: disabled
DropzoneButton.description: Disables both the dropzone and the trigger button.

DropzoneButton.name: idleLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the heading text shown while the dropzone is idle, and doubles as its accessible label.

DropzoneButton.name: acceptLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the heading text shown while a dragged file is being validated as acceptable.

DropzoneButton.name: rejectLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the heading text shown while a dragged file would be rejected.

DropzoneButton.name: description
DropzoneButton.default: "Drag and drop files here, or use the file picker."
DropzoneButton.description: Renders supporting text below the heading describing how to use the dropzone.

DropzoneButton.name: buttonLabel
DropzoneButton.description: Sets the label of the button that opens the native file picker.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI DropzoneButton at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; drop/reject callbacks, constraints and user-facing text are configurable.

items.name: header-mega-menu
items.title: Header Mega Menu
items.description: Responsive site header with a hover-card feature mega-menu that collapses into a mobile drawer.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: logo
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Rendered at the start of the header bar; nothing renders when omitted.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: links
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Ordered nav links rendered in the header bar and the mobile drawer. At most one entry should set `features`: only the first entry that does renders as the mega-menu (a hover-card dropdown on desktop, a collapsible section on mobile); `features` on any later entry is ignored.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: featuresViewAllHref
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Href for the mega-menu's "View all" link; the link is omitted when unset.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: featuresFooterHeading
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Heading shown in the mega-menu's footer callout.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: featuresFooterDescription
HeaderMegaMenu.default: "Everything you need to explore what's possible and start building."
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Body copy shown in the mega-menu's footer callout.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: featuresFooterActionLabel
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Label for the mega-menu footer's action button; clicking it calls `onSignUp`.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: loginLabel
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Label for the log in button, shown in the header and the mobile drawer.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: signUpLabel
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Label for the sign up button, shown in the header and the mobile drawer.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: onLogin
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Called when a log in button (header or drawer) is clicked.

HeaderMegaMenu.name: onSignUp
HeaderMegaMenu.description: Called when a sign up button (header or drawer) or the mega-menu footer's action button is clicked.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI HeaderMegaMenu at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; feature-grid mock data and the two CTA labels became typed props, the fixed nav links became a consumer-supplied array, and the upstream @mantinex/mantine-logo import (not part of this workspace) became a logo ReactNode prop. Kept as an opinionated block with internal CSS classes rather than a public Styles API, consistent with this catalog's other page-section blocks (authentication-form, stats-grid, table-sort).

items.name: navbar-nested
items.title: Nested Navbar
items.description: Collapsible sidebar navigation with nested link groups and a user footer.

NavbarNested.name: links
NavbarNested.description: Ordered top-level nav entries; each entry sets either `link` to render a leaf that navigates directly, or `links` to render a group whose secondary links collapse beneath it (and may set `initiallyOpened`).

NavbarNested.name: user
NavbarNested.description: Name, email and optional avatar rendered in the footer user row.

NavbarNested.name: versionLabel
NavbarNested.description: Text for the version badge next to the logo; no badge renders when omitted.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI NavbarNested at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908, merged with its NavbarLinksGroup and UserButton siblings; the mock nav tree, avatar and version badge became typed props, dead leaf-link buttons became real anchors, and the sidebar now fills a height-constrained parent (see the usage example) instead of a fixed 800px demo height.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: A TextInput whose label floats above the field on focus or fill, with an absorbed invalid/error state.

FloatingLabelInput.name: label
FloatingLabelInput.description: TextInput label text, rendered floating above the field on focus or fill.

FloatingLabelInput.name: placeholder
FloatingLabelInput.description: TextInput placeholder shown while the field is empty and unfocused.

FloatingLabelInput.name: required
FloatingLabelInput.description: Renders the asterisk, which fades in only while the label is floating.

FloatingLabelInput.name: autoComplete
FloatingLabelInput.description: Browser-autofill-suppression default carried over from upstream.

FloatingLabelInput.name: value
FloatingLabelInput.description: Controlled value. When provided, this component is fully controlled and onChange is the only way its displayed value changes.

FloatingLabelInput.name: defaultValue
FloatingLabelInput.description: Initial value for uncontrolled usage. Ignored once value is provided.

FloatingLabelInput.name: onChange
FloatingLabelInput.description: Fires on every keystroke regardless of controlled/uncontrolled mode; matches TextInput's own onChange signature.

FloatingLabelInput.name: error
FloatingLabelInput.description: Inherited from TextInputProps. Renders the red invalid border/background and the error message, and composes with the floating label.

FloatingLabelInput.name: errorIcon
FloatingLabelInput.description: Shown in the right section only while error is set; pass null to keep the invalid styling without an icon.

FloatingLabelInput.name: ...others
FloatingLabelInput.description: All other TextInputProps are forwarded to the underlying TextInput (size, radius, disabled, leftSection, wrapperProps, description, id, name, etc). variant is intentionally not exposed — the CSS module assumes Mantine's default input chrome. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI FloatingLabelInput and InputValidation at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; absorbed InputValidation's error state into one component, label/placeholder/required/autoComplete became props, and a missing aria-hidden on the decorative error icon was fixed.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password Strength
items.description: PasswordInput with a four-segment strength meter and a live, overridable requirements checklist.

PasswordStrength.name: value
PasswordStrength.description: Controlled value. Omit to let the component manage its own state.

PasswordStrength.name: onChange
PasswordStrength.description: Called with the next value on every keystroke, controlled or uncontrolled alike.

PasswordStrength.name: minLength
PasswordStrength.description: Minimum character count the length requirement checks for; replaces upstream's hardcoded > 5.

PasswordStrength.name: requirements
PasswordStrength.description: { re: RegExp; label: string } pairs checked against the value. The exported default mirrors upstream's list; consumers can extend rather than fork it.

PasswordStrength.name: ...others
PasswordStrength.description: Forwarded to the root wrapper; native onChange is excluded so the custom string-valued onChange can't collide with it. Mantine Styles API props (classNames, styles, unstyled) are also accepted.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI PasswordStrength at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; requirements/minLength/label/placeholder became props, controlled and uncontrolled usage is now supported via useUncontrolled, and per-segment aria-labels plus live-region summaries were added for accessibility.

items.name: autocomplete-loading
items.title: Autocomplete Loading
items.description: Debounced async Autocomplete with a loading indicator and race-safe request handling.

AutocompleteLoading.name: value
AutocompleteLoading.description: Controlled value. When provided, this component is fully controlled and onChange is the only way its displayed value changes; composes with the async loadOptions flow so an external write cancels any pending request for the previous text.

AutocompleteLoading.name: defaultValue
AutocompleteLoading.description: Initial value for uncontrolled usage. Ignored once value is provided.

AutocompleteLoading.name: onChange
AutocompleteLoading.description: Called on every keystroke with the raw input value, not debounced.

AutocompleteLoading.name: debounceMs
AutocompleteLoading.description: Delay, in milliseconds, after typing stops before loadOptions runs.

AutocompleteLoading.name: loadOptions
AutocompleteLoading.description: Fetches suggestions for the current query. Defaults to a demo implementation that suggests the query at common email domains; replace with a real request in production.

AutocompleteLoading.name: shouldQuery
AutocompleteLoading.description: Decides whether loadOptions should run for a given query; returning false clears any pending request and turns the loader off.

AutocompleteLoading.name: filter
AutocompleteLoading.description: Forwarded to Autocomplete's own client-side filter. Defaults to a pass-through since loadOptions results are already server-filtered.

AutocompleteLoading.name: ...others
AutocompleteLoading.description: Every other Autocomplete prop is forwarded, including classNames/styles/unstyled/vars (Autocomplete's own Styles API), size, disabled, error, comboboxProps, limit, maxDropdownHeight, renderOption, clearable, etc.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI AutocompleteLoading at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; the fake setTimeout fetch became a loadOptions prop, the pending timeout is now cleared on unmount, requests are race-safe via a monotonic request id, and a pass-through filter was added so a real search's results aren't silently re-filtered client-side.

items.name: hero-image-right
items.title: Hero Image Right
items.description: Full-bleed marketing hero with a gradient-highlighted headline, body copy, primary/optional-secondary CTAs, and an opt-in background photo revealed by a diagonal gradient on the right.

HeroImageRight.name: titleBefore
HeroImageRight.description: Text rendered before the highlighted phrase in the headline.

HeroImageRight.name: highlightedText
HeroImageRight.description: The gradient-highlighted phrase in the headline.

HeroImageRight.name: titleAfter
HeroImageRight.description: Text rendered after the highlighted phrase in the headline.

HeroImageRight.name: description
HeroImageRight.description: Supporting body copy below the headline.

HeroImageRight.name: primaryButtonLabel
HeroImageRight.description: Label for the always-rendered primary CTA.

HeroImageRight.name: primaryButtonHref
HeroImageRight.description: Renders the primary CTA as an anchor instead of a button when set.

HeroImageRight.name: onPrimaryButtonClick
HeroImageRight.description: Click handler for the primary CTA when no href is set.

HeroImageRight.name: secondaryButtonLabel
HeroImageRight.description: Label for an optional secondary CTA; the button renders only when this is supplied.

HeroImageRight.name: secondaryButtonHref
HeroImageRight.description: Renders the secondary CTA as an anchor instead of a button when set.

HeroImageRight.name: onSecondaryButtonClick
HeroImageRight.description: Click handler for the secondary CTA when no href is set.

HeroImageRight.name: backgroundImageUrl
HeroImageRight.description: URL of a photo shown behind the gradient overlay on the right side of the hero; with no value the hero renders as a plain gradient/navy panel with no third-party host dependency.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI HeroImageRight at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; the hardcoded Unsplash photo became an opt-in backgroundImageUrl prop (unset by default), the headline split into three props around the gradient highlight, and an optional secondary CTA was added alongside upstream's single button.

items.name: footer-links
items.title: Footer Links
items.description: Multi-column site footer with a brand block, titled link groups, copyright line and social icons — all consumer-supplied.

FooterLinks.name: logo
FooterLinks.description: Rendered at the start of the brand block; nothing renders when omitted.

FooterLinks.name: tagline
FooterLinks.description: Short description under the logo; omitted when unset.

FooterLinks.name: groups
FooterLinks.description: Titled link columns, each { title: string; links: readonly FooterLinksLink[] }; this is the component's whole point.

FooterLinks.name: copyright
FooterLinks.description: Copyright/legal line in the bottom bar; omitted when unset.

FooterLinks.name: socialLinks
FooterLinks.description: { href, icon, label } per entry; label becomes the icon link's aria-label. The entire bottom-bar social row is omitted when unset or empty.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI FooterLinks at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; the three hardcoded link groups became the groups prop, the upstream MantineLogo import became an optional logo slot, the tagline/copyright strings became optional props with no fake placeholder default, and the fixed social icons became a consumer-supplied socialLinks array.

items.name: faq-simple
items.title: FAQ Simple
items.description: Centered FAQ section with a separated accordion of consumer-supplied question/answer pairs.

FaqSimple.name: titleOrder
FaqSimple.description: Heading level for title. Upstream leaves Title at Mantine's own default of 1; this port defaults to 2 so dropping the section into a page that already has an h1 doesn't produce two.

FaqSimple.name: items
FaqSimple.description: The question/answer list; FaqSimpleItem is { question: string; answer: ReactNode; value?: string }, value is the Accordion item id and defaults to faq-${index} when omitted.

FaqSimple.name: variant
FaqSimple.description: Accordion visual variant; upstream's hardcoded value.

FaqSimple.name: chevronPosition
FaqSimple.description: Which side the expand chevron renders on; upstream never set this explicitly.

FaqSimple.name: controlOrder
FaqSimple.description: Heading level (2-6) each Accordion.Control renders inside; defaults to one level below titleOrder. Upstream never set Accordion's order, leaving controls as bare buttons outside the page heading outline — this fixes that.

FaqSimple.name: defaultValue
FaqSimple.description: Value of the item open on mount; nothing is open by default, matching upstream.

items.docs: Adapted from Mantine UI FaqSimple at ffbf61c559f374a7ea28fcf00355e84dcbe9a908; the hardcoded title and Q&A list became props, variant became configurable, and two heading-hierarchy bugs were fixed — Title's implicit h1 (now titleOrder, default 2) and Accordion controls rendering as bare buttons with no place in the page's heading outline (now controlOrder).
